description.value:
Frequency once per character level

Requirement Willing target with Resonance 1 or higher.

You perform a Walk-back 2 rite — the same rite Wardbreaker's unbinding, the Choir of Ash's rite, or a Seed-Warden's Grove-Bind would otherwise take a week of downtime to complete — in a single action, right now, on a willing target. It reduces the target's Resonance by 1, exactly as the week-long version would. This still only works once per character level, same as the ordinary rite, and the two don't stack into two uses at the same level.
